FAQ

PETG vs PVC: Which is better?
PETG is the industry standard for high-quality shrink sleeves. It is more eco-friendly (recyclable with PET bottles) and offers higher shrinkage for complex bottle shapes.

Do you provide roll or single cut?
We provide both. Rolls are for automatic sleeve applicators; single cuts are for manual application using a heat gun or steam tunnel.

Can I get a matte finish?
Yes. We can apply a matte lacquer to give your labels a premium, non-reflective look.

Technical Specification

Custom Shrink Sleeve Labels Technical Specification

The table below is written for industrial RFQ comparison. Final shrinkage performance depends on the heat/steam tunnel settings and container shape.

Material structurePETG 40µm / 45µm / 50µm (Eco-friendly); PVC 40µm (Economy)
Shrinkage percentageTD (Transverse Direction) 70–78% for PETG; MD (Machine Direction) 0–3%
Printing technologyReverse gravure printing (high-speed) or UV flexo; up to 10 colors
Lay-flat Width (LFW)20mm to 350mm; Repeat confirmed by container height
PerforationVertical, Horizontal, or T-perforation for tamper-evident caps
Supply FormRolls for automatic application; Single cut for manual application
Surface finishHigh Gloss, Matte, Metallic, Pearlized, UV Spot
Printing registration tolerance±0.3 mm for high-definition graphics
Recommended testShrink-to-fit test with container + friction test for applicators
MOQ500 PCS per custom size / artwork
Artwork fileAI / PDF / PSD accepted; vector logo required; 3 mm bleed
Color toleranceΔE ≤ 3.0 against approved digital proof
Dimension tolerance±0.5 mm on Lay-flat width
Quality inspectionAQL 2.5 for major defects; 100% video inspection for color consistency
RFQ data requiredContainer drawing/dimensions, material, artwork, quantity, destination

RFQ Checklist for Factory Quotation

  1. Confirm container dimensions or send a sample for shrinkage calculation.
  2. Send AI/PDF artwork with 3 mm bleed and reverse printing requirement.
  3. Choose material (PETG vs PVC) and perforation requirement.
  4. Tell us destination country, quantity and delivery method.
